settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Rest the massager over your shoulders, slip your hands through the loops, and let its weight settle. Start on low heat for the first few minutes, then choose your kneading intensity. Ten to fifteen minutes per session is plenty.

settings.heading: Materials
settings.content: Breathable knit outer in Sand or Charcoal, plush inner lining, and a washable cover. No latex, no synthetic fragrance.

settings.heading: Shipping + returns
settings.content: Free shipping on all orders. 60-night home trial — if it doesn't change how your shoulders feel, send it back for a full refund.
